question: Should aider's source (~/dev/src/aider) stand on every cairn box, so aider_shim's proofs run as written everywhere, or only on the box that runs the aider device, with the proofs judging a measured record of aider's call shapes elsewhere?
why_it_blocks: Measured 2026-11-13: aider_shim test_fence.py and test_translation.py red 4 teeth on akienasus because ~/dev/src/aider is absent; the fix differs by answer (a bootstrap install, or a fixture plus the live read).
answer: Outline 5.5.3.8: "A device runs on one box; the other boxes reach it over the buses. No box needs a full set of devices." So aider's source stands only on the box that runs the aider device (outline 13); on every other box aider_shim's proofs judge a measured record of aider's call shapes, or reach that box over the bus.
